summary: Retest after iteration_57. Everything you asked us to fix passes. Backend: 14/14 new pytest tests pass (test_iteration58_quiz_session_anticheat.py). Quiz sessions: GET returns session_id, /answer needs it, only the first choice is kept, the score comes from the stored choices (the client's answer_index is ignored), a second save gets 409, saving the same game 4 times at once gives one 200 and three 409, unknown, missing or expired (>6h) sessions get 400, another user's session gets 400. Free limit now counts answered questions: 3 fetches still give 5 questions, 5 parallel /answer calls across 2 sessions accept exactly 5, a 6th new question gets 403, 2 answers leave 3 questions. client_ip uses the egress IP and ignores a spoofed 'X-Forwarded-For: 9.9.9.9, 8.8.8.8'. Reset token: 5 parallel uses give one 200 and four 400. Contact and packages work. Frontend (Playwright): free user registers on mobile 390px with the consent banner open (body padding 220px, submit button above the banner, clickable without force). Quiz shows 5 questions after the StrictMode double fetch and a reload; answering 5 saves; Rejouer then shows quiz-daily-limit. Premium admin: a game of 30 questions, forced 503 on save shows quiz-save-error, Réessayer saves (200). Rejouer starts a fresh game and that save also works. When a save reaches the server but the response is lost (502), Réessayer gets 409 and the game counts as saved (no error left). 401 interceptor: in-app navigation to /app/famille after cookies are cleared goes to /login?session=expiree&next=%2Fapp%2Ffamille, and logging in lands on /app/famille. next=/login and next=//evil.com both go to /app/dashboard. Family mode (2 players, pass, answer), /app/pricing and /contact all work. 2 new holes: a player can save only part of the answered questions to inflate accuracy, and options come in database order where 68% of correct answers are option 0.

minor.issue: A player can save only some of the questions answered in a session. Reproduced: 6 answered, 3 right; saving only the 3 right ids stores 3/3 (100%) instead of 3/6. This inflates accuracy_pct, mastery and 'perfect score' type badges (XP is not affected). Fix: total = sess.answered_count (or len(sess.answers)), score over every stored answer, ignore the payload's subset; or reject when set(question_ids) != set(sess.answers).

Options come back in database order and correct_index is heavily skewed: 1368 of 2005 questions (68%) have correct_index=0. Someone scripting the API who always picks choice 0 gets about 68% right with no knowledge. The frontend shuffles, but the API does not. Fix: shuffle options on the server for each session and store the mapping in quiz_sessions (or rebalance correct_index in the data).

Free limit check and write are not atomic: answered_today() is read before the update. A 10-way parallel test held at exactly 5, but a tight race could let through 6 or 7. Low impact. Fix: a per-user-per-day counter doc with conditional $inc ($lt 5).

Counts answered_count of sessions CREATED since Paris midnight. A session opened at 23:58 and answered after midnight counts toward yesterday, so a free user can get up to 10 answers around midnight. Edge case.

integration_issues.issue: Questions where every player passed are never sent to /answer. They are left out of answers, so the saved total is lower than the number of questions (e.g. 28/28 instead of 28/30). Not new; flagging because the attempt total is now based on answered questions.

integration_issues.flow: Free quiz with a second tab
integration_issues.issue: If /answer returns 403 (daily limit used up in another tab) the player gets a toast, the choice resets, and the quiz has no exit or limit screen. Suggest showing quiz-daily-limit when /answer returns 403.

issues: The navbar shows marketing and app links together (Quiz du Jour, Catégories, Essai gratuit, Tarifs, Offrir, Bien vieillir, Mes quiz, Jeux, Ligues, Niv, Crédits, Mon compte, Admin, Quitter). It overflows: the 'Quitter' button and 'Confort +' are cut off on the right edge.

action_items: POST /attempts: compute score and total from every stored session answer (or reject a payload that is a subset), so players cannot inflate accuracy by leaving out wrong answers
Shuffle options per session on the server (store the mapping) or rebalance correct_index (68% are 0)

Update or retire /app/backend/tests/test_iteration57_security_audit.py. 7 of its tests fail only because they use the old /answer and /attempts contract without session_id; the other 8 (auth, token_version, promo, coop, pricing) still pass
Optional: make the free-limit check atomic; handle 403 from /answer in QuizPlayer by showing the daily-limit screen
Fix the navbar overflow on /app/pricing for logged-in users at desktop width
critical_code_review_comments: quiz.py get_questions: unused local day_start (line 121) and re-import of timedelta inside the function
quiz.py check_answer: after the update_one there is a re-read but no check of modified_count. It is fine because the first choice wins, but the 403 check before it is a TOCTOU
save_attempt: total=len(body.answers) trusts the client's subset (see backend minor #1)
reset_password: the token is marked used before the expiry check. Fine for security, but the second update_one is redundant apart from used_at
QuizPlayer.jsx is 662 lines, close to the 700-line split threshold
